subject: Educação Física
description_pt: Experimentar e fruir brincadeiras e jogos populares do Brasil e do mundo, incluindo aqueles de matriz indígena e africana, e recriá-los, valorizando a importância desse patrimônio histórico cultural.

components.description_pt: Explorar jogos populares e tradições de brincadeira do Brasil e do mundo, incluindo origens indígenas e africanas
components.description_en: Explore popular games and play traditions from Brazil and around the world, including Indigenous and African origin
components.cc_component_description: Identify cultural elements in fables and folktales from diverse traditions

components.description_pt: Recriar jogos populares e tradições de brincadeira do Brasil e do mundo na prática
components.description_en: Recreate popular games and play traditions from Brazil and around the world in practice

components.description_pt: Reconhecer o patrimônio histórico e cultural representado por jogos populares e tradições de brincadeira
components.description_en: Recognize the historical and cultural heritage represented by popular games and play traditions
components.cc_component_description: Identify cultural elements in fables and folktales from diverse traditions

cc_matches.description: Recount stories, including fables and folktales from diverse cultures, and determine their central message, lesson, or moral.
